scientific_limitations: Exact five-by-five quotient only; no general board family, complete homotopy type or integral row-permutation module. Intrinsic three-torsion in the unquotiented chessboard complex was already known.
title: Mixed-prime homology and a purely modular symmetry class in a cyclic chessboard quotient
